title: Keywords for Categories | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
content: Keywords for Categories Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000064323 Overview The Keywords for Categories add-on expands the search functionality on the website by allowing keywords and tags to be added to individual member categories. Users performing text searches on the site will be connected with more members. Adding keywords to the categories increases the search value of members within those categories. How To Get This Add-On Websites with the VIP Add-Ons Club automatically have this add-on available: Join The VIP Add-Ons Club Purchase Individually: Keywords For Categories Add-On Enabling the Add-On 1. Go to Members - Member Categories. 2. On the right side of the categories it will add a field to add the keywords for the specific category: If you don't see this field please contact support HERE. Important: Do not use the same keyword(s) on multiple categories, they should be unique keywords per category. Also, do not use existing categories as keywords. For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard . Was this article helpful and accurate?
